samples.description: Event-grain completed U.S. common-stock SEOs issued in 1987–2006 after the paper’s SDC and Compustat screens. Each SDC deal remains a separate offering. Table 6 outcomes use year-1 matched ROA changes; controls are nonissuers matched on prior assets and closest year-0 ROA.

assumptions: The paper does not specify the event-to-fiscal-year mapping; use SDC issue calendar year as Compustat FYEAR year 0 and the next FYEAR as year 1.
The paper does not give the growth formula; use year-over-year percentage growth in SALE and CAPX with a positive, observed prior-year denominator.
The paper does not state the ROA matching period or tie rule; match on year-0 ROA and break exact ties by ascending GVKEY, allowing control reuse.
Use a constant in each Table 6 cross-section because the paper does not state its constant convention; omit the constant from the exported rows.

Match the SDC offer-date CUSIP to COMP.SEC_IDHIST CUSIP rows effective on that date, prefer exact nine-character matches, fall back to dated six-character matches, and exclude links that resolve to multiple GVKEYs. COMP.FUNDA.CUSIP is not treated as historical.

limitations: The source does not report the year-0 sales-growth or capex-growth formulas, the Table 6 constant convention, the ROA matching period, the matching tie rule, or exact event-to-fiscal-year alignment; documented choices are in design.md.

The local source screens and dated Compustat crosswalk may produce a different event count and year coverage from the published 1,511-offer sample. No screens or transformations were selected to target the published counts or coefficients.
The final local handoff contains 2,351 offers over 1990–2006, versus 1,511 offers in the paper; the documented attrition and source-link counts do not isolate one cause for the difference.
The 1990 D/E/F complete-case cross-sections each have N=3 and only two identified slopes; those annual fits are omitted, leaving 16 full-rank years for those columns.

Table 6 average adjusted R-squared is computed as the equal-weighted mean of native annual OLS adjusted R-squared across the actual full-rank cross-sections, multiplied by 100 to match the paper’s percent units. The separate r2 row remains xtfmb’s mean unadjusted R-squared as a fraction.
